_source: Email-domain intelligence. NOT in the dataset: the transaction file gives a domain string and nothing else. The class of a domain -- who operates it, what it costs to open an account there, whether it is tied to a billing relationship -- is external knowledge, and it is the kind of thing a fraud desk buys from a vendor. Compiled here from public knowledge of the operators rather than fetched at runtime, so the agent works offline and the demo is reproducible.

_classes.isp_tied: opened as part of a paid internet, cable or phone subscription, which means a billing relationship and a credit check stand behind it
_classes.free_webmail: free, ubiquitous, no barrier to opening -- the default for most real people and most fraudsters alike
_classes.privacy_or_niche: free but deliberately private, or a small provider with weak or no identity checks
_classes.masked: the merchant or processor withheld the address; 'anonymous.com' is Vesta's placeholder, not a real domain
